caption: The drawing consists of a large square composition centered on a beige or off-white background. The square is bordered by a thick red band composed of a repeating pattern of rectangles and squares in varying shades of red, arranged in a grid-like layout. Inside this border, the central area is filled with a tightly organized grid of alternating blue and tan rectangles. The blue rectangles are decorated with various patterns, including small crosses and geometric motifs, while the tan rectangles are filled with densely packed dots and small grid patterns in blue. The blue and tan rectangles are interspersed with thin red lines running horizontally and vertically, creating a checkered effect. The entire patterned area is made up of small, geometric and repeating motifs, giving the appearance of a woven textile. In the lower right corner, there is the signature "Christoffel."
title: Coverlet (Section)
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
